authored_profiles: All reference payloads, classroom/game examples, thresholds other than cited contrast criteria, traces and tiny media fixture were authored for diagnostics, not independently validated research instruments.
fixture_basis_hash_semantics: source_refs[].basis_sha256 in these authored fixtures is digest(reference.payload), not the SHA of SPEC.md or a retrieved webpage. The locator names the supporting implementation specification; the manifest separately binds its file bytes.
